items.text: Justin Jefferson listed OUT for Sunday with ankle injury per ETR comprehensive injury report.
items.why: Sprained ankle; ruled out on final report.
items.implication: Major WR1 void; elevates secondary options in MIN offense.
items.opportunity: Increased target share and routes for remaining WRs.

items.text: Dallas Goedert OUT (with Devonta Smith and others) on ETR Sunday injury list.
items.why: Injury designation final; paired with Smith/Baun absences.
items.implication: Eagles offense without three key pieces vs Rams.

items.text: Eagles ruled out WR DeVonta Smith for Sunday vs Rams due to hamstring.
items.implication: Eagles pass catchers thinned significantly with Goedert also out.

items.text: Jets ruled out RB Breece Hall (and WR Adonai Mitchell) for Sunday vs Bears.
items.implication: Full RB workload shifts to backups; NYJ run game impacted.

items.text: Excellent spot for Nico Collins return: Cowboys inflate opposing WR scoring 7.3% (most in NFL); Texans 7th-most implied points.
items.why: DvP data + team total; hamstring return timing ideal.
items.implication: Strong WR1/WR2 fantasy play with volume upside.

items.text: Great to have Puka Nacua (hip) back; speculation on possible snap limits, monitor.
items.why: Return confirmed but workload uncertainty post-hip.
items.implication: Startable but ceiling may be capped if limited.
items.opportunity: Still high routes if unrestricted; Adams competition.
items.conflict: Possible limits vs full WR1 expectation

items.text: Jordan Addison truthers moment: home vs borderline NFL secondary with Justin Jefferson out.
items.why: Jefferson absence creates clear target vacuum in favorable spot.
items.implication: Elevated WR2/flex with WR1 upside this week.

items.text: Eagles situation worse: without three key players (DeVonta Smith, Dallas Goedert, Zack Baun) vs Rams.
items.implication: Hurts/PHI pass game less efficient; remaining pass-catchers volatile.

items.text: Nico Collins is good to go (ACTIVE) for Texans vs Cowboys.
items.why: Hamstring cleared; official good to go.
items.implication: Elite WR return in strong matchup.
items.opportunity: Full target share vs weak Cowboys secondary.

items.text: Puka Nacua expected to play; Aaron Donald out with back injury.
items.why: Hip issue resolved enough for expected return.
items.implication: Rams WR corps boosted; possible snap limits per analysts.
items.opportunity: High-volume WR1 role if full, or shared.

items.text: Jaylen Warren LOVE: 90% snaps last week, 20/22 RB touches; full workhorse with Dowdle out again vs CLE allowing 88+ rush yds every game.
items.why: Elite snap/touch share + matchup + teammate out.
items.opportunity: Near every-down role including third down.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love LOVE: RB5 utilization, 26 touches (more than W1+W2 combined); double-digit target share every game; Giants allow 5.1 YPC (3rd-most).
items.why: Exploding usage + receiving role + soft run D.

items.text: Jadarian Price tough early: lost GL/base to Wilson, pass to Holani, fumbles, chest hurt, Charbonnet back at practice. Eye test still positive long-term; far from over.
items.implication: Near-term fantasy limited; stash for longer term.
items.conflict: Positive eye test vs current usage losses

items.text: Omarion Hampton HATE: RB27 utilization, 3.5% targets, 25% routes, snaps down to 42% (13% 3rd down); SEA allows only 2.9 YPC (2nd-fewest).
